name: Shadow

specialAbilities.name: Amorphous
specialAbilities.description: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

specialAbilities.name: Sunlight Weakness
specialAbilities.description: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

specialAbilities.name: Shadow Stealth
specialAbilities.description: Bonus Action. While in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

actions.name: Draining Swipe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by 1d4.
